parsed.rationale_overall: System B provides more precise, actionable numeric guidance (specific monthly savings amounts, avalanche method, match math) and adds a valuable 401(k) match recommendation directly tied to the user's stable income. System A has a factual inconsistency (Rec #1 suggests 31.2% allocation to savings while telling the user to redirect all contributions there) and slightly weaker personalization compared to B's tighter linkage between profile attributes and actions.
